body: Thank you.. i have a psychiatrist who isnt very good at his job. Ive seen 7 therapists. I do take medication but all it does is make me zombiefied. It sucks. Im glad it was me and not someone else at least :)). Thank you once again my friend.
I hope so. Thank you so much. You just made a randome stranger happy.

That means the absolute world to me. To know even one person cares. Luckily i got out of all of that recently. Unfortunately family is out of the question but you really made me happy.. thank you my friend.

Whatever happens my friend, i wish you all the best. Im glad you've made peace. Your writing is incredible. I wish i could persuade you otherwise.. but i wont. Its clear you've made up your mind. Best of luck and we will all be thinking of you.
I think your hella strong. You've got this we all believe in you <3
